messages:
ana_release: Heads-up: proposing we unpin runtime v2.17 on canary tonight (23:30 UTC) to validate the new kernel picker with quant-v4. This unpin will also exercise SDK 3.5. Quick volunteers for fast compatibility checks?

liam_engineering: I can run a lightweight regression against our internal prompt-suite. Note: SDK 3.5 changed chunked streaming framing; older client shims might drop trailing tokens.

tess_platform: Runtime 2.17 includes the kernel-selector perf tweak but also the memory boundary check fix. We should monitor OOMs closely. I'll stage the build to hosted-staging at 22:40 for smoke.

owen_sre: Telemetry baseline: last canary with 2.16 had no OOMs but did show a small increase in tail latency for batch sizes > 8. Set alert thresholds accordingly.

deploybot: Preflight scheduled at 23:00 UTC. Checks: model-compat, runtime-smoke, sdk-compat, infra-alarms. Will report aggregated result.

ana_release: Minor note: release notes need a line about the kernel selector and the memory boundary fix. I'll draft and post to #release-notes before unpin.

liam_engineering: Running local regression now. If streaming framing is the issue, we can add a compatibility fallback in shim that accepts both framing versions. ETA ~20m.

tess_platform: If anyone needs the staging endpoint: https://staging.canary.eu-west.redwood.internal. Also recommend setting a temporary model-route hold to avoid automatic unpin for 1h while we validate.

own_sre: Gating metrics: 99th latency delta < +10%, error-rate < 0.05%, and no OOMs in staging. SDK incompatibility = hard block.

deploybot: Preflight results: model-check: OK; runtime-smoke: OK; infra-alarms: OK; sdk-compat: WARN(stream-framing: partial mismatch). Aggregated: WARN.

ana_release: Since deploybot returned WARN for SDK, we should not auto-unpin. Liam, any chance the shim fallback lands before 23:00?

liam_engineering: I have a minimal shim branch ready: https://github.com/redwood/shims/pull/1301. It's a single-file fallback and tests pass locally. Need a quick review and CI. If merged by 22:50 we can re-run preflight.

tess_platform: I'll queue a staging promote after CI green. Also adding the pin hold with deploybot command to prevent auto-unpin while we iterate.

ana_release: Please run this if you add the hold:
```
/deploybot pin add --scope canary --target runtime:2.17 --until 2026-03-24T00:30:00Z --reason "hold for SDK shim validation"
```

lick: (typo)

own_sre: Small ops note: if we end up rolling back we should prefer a targeted route rollback to runtime=2.16 for canary, not a full global rollback. Follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pin-unpin-rollback.

liam_engineering: PR is up and requested reviewers. Link above.

deploybot: Action: adding canary hold for runtime:2.17 until 00:30 UTC. Will re-run preflight at 22:55 UTC after CI.

tess_platform: Staging promote started. Smoke tests running (~6m). Will post logs if anything fails.

liam_engineering: CI green and merged. Triggering staging smoke.

deploybot: Re-run preflight (22:55 UTC): model-check: OK; runtime-smoke: OK; infra-alarms: OK; sdk-compat: OK. Aggregated: OK.

ana_release: Great. Proceed with unpin at 23:30 UTC but hold for 30m of observation. If any alert fires during observation we revert to 2.16 on canary and open a rollback thread.

own_sre: I'll be on-call watch during the observation window and will trigger rollback if latency or OOM thresholds breach.

tess_platform: Posting release note draft: "runtime v2.17: kernel selector optimization, memory boundary safety fix, improved batch scheduling. Note: requires SDK >=3.5 for correct streaming framing." Please review and ack.

liam_engineering: ACK.

ana_release: Unpin executed at 23:30 UTC by deploybot. Observing... :eyes:

deploybot: Soft-pin removed for runtime:2.17 on canary at 23:30 UTC. Observation window until 00:00 UTC.

own_sre: Monitoring: no OOMs, error-rate stable. 99th latency +4% (within gate).

tess_platform: Staging logs clean. No kernel warnings.

ana_release: After 30m observation looks good. We'll promote to a larger cohort tomorrow morning. I'll update release notes and notify product. Thanks everyone :partyparrot:
